[Thinking]
**Clarifying triangle degrees**

The user asked in Norwegian about the degrees in a right-angled triangle. This could refer to the total degrees of angles in the triangle or just the right angle itself. Generally, all triangles sum to 180 degrees. In the case of a right-angled triangle, there’s one 90-degree angle, and the other two angles add up to 90 degrees. To keep it clear, I’ll mention both points in my answer!
[/Thinking]

180°. I en rettvinklet trekant er én vinkel 90°, og de to andre vinklene til sammen 90°, slik at summen blir 180°.
